title: Shimla's Crowded Streets Distract from Mattian's Serenity
summary: Shimla's crowded streets were a distraction from the serenity of Mattian, where a group of people gathered to pay their respects. The event took place in Mattian, near Shimla, on October 15th. A total of 500 people attended the gathering, which was organized by local residents. The police presence was notable, with over 200 officers deployed to maintain order. The government has not commented on the incident, while opposition parties have alleged that the crackdown on protesters was excessive.
